features.name: FastAPI app + no-cache middleware
features.detail: Single FastAPI app on port 8777 (LOTTERYWIZ_PORT override). ~45 endpoints. A middleware sends Cache-Control: no-store on .js/.css/.html and the mounted index pages so a single-user dev edit shows on reload.

features.name: Static mounts (4 apps + results)
features.detail: Mounts /general (Universal), /scratch, /supersete, /results (each StaticFiles html=True), and / -> Fantasy5/. GET / serves Fantasy5/index.html.

features.name: Run launcher
features.detail: Double-click launcher: cd to dir, python server.py, open http://localhost:8777. launch.json also has fantasy5 (:8777) + fantasy5dev (:8778) for iterating without touching the live service.

features.name: Owner-key loader
features.detail: Reads LOTTERYWIZ_OWNER_KEY env, else gitignored .owner_key, else generates one with secrets.token_urlsafe and writes it. GET /api/owner/check validates constant-time via hmac.compare_digest and never returns the key.

features.name: Covering-design wheel
features.detail: Greedy set-cover over t-subsets of the pool: enumerate t-subsets needed, repeatedly pick the candidate ticket covering the most still-uncovered t-subsets until all are covered or guard trips.

features.name: Structured generator
features.detail: Targets sum range, odd/low balance, max-consec via fits(); samples candidates, scores by pair-overlap (x10) minus optional hot weight, keeps lowest. Relax fallback when constraints can't be met. seed-deterministic.

features.name: Curated pipeline
features.detail: combinations(pool,5) -> drop past draws -> drop is_edge() shapes -> sort by profile_score (gaussian sum->107, odd/low near 2-3, zero-consec, spread, novelty) -> coverage-aware greedy top-N minimising pair reuse. Returns funnel + pair/triple coverage + stats. Refuses pools that make >200k combos.

features.name: Brutal Ledger replay
features.detail: Bitmask each ticket and each draw; per draw sum payouts via popcount (bit_count). Returns spend, recovered, net, roi, per-tier counts, equity curve, best_win, worst_losing_streak.

features.name: Monte-Carlo control
features.detail: Random quick-pick has the SAME hypergeometric match distribution by symmetry, so a run's recovered total is one multinomial over n_tickets*n_draws trials. numpy rng.multinomial (pure-python fallback). Returns sorted net P/L list.

features.name: Probability + backtest
features.detail: p_exactly via hypergeometric; p_any_atleast over T tickets. backtest tallies best-ticket match tier per draw. check_set scores a set vs a winning draw (per-ticket hits, tier, payout).

features.name: Draws + frequency
features.detail: Reads Fantasy5/draws_store.json; frequency table over 1..42; ranked hottest-first; hot/cold helpers for the pool picker.

features.name: Odds & prize tiers
features.detail: Hypergeometric over arbitrary ticket size k vs draw size D (handles Lotomania pick-50/draw-20, Timemania pick-10/draw-7) times bonus pool C(Bn,b). Verified exact vs published odds.

features.name: Generalized covering wheel
features.detail: dcode-style greedy t-cover for any pool/k/t: enumerates k-subsets when C(v,k)<=60000 else samples. Returns tickets + the plain-English guarantee.

features.name: Auto-derived profile + curated
features.detail: derive_profile computes each game's sum hotzone (observed percentiles), odd/low targets and low/high split from ITS own draws; the curated funnel generalizes with a relax-fallback for concentrated pools.

features.name: Generalized ledger + control + backtest
features.detail: Parameterized by (N,k): cost-aware replay, multinomial random control and best-tier backtest for any game, mirroring the F5 engine.

features.name: Bonus-ball attach + Super Sete
features.detail: attach_bonus adds the independent bonus ball (rotate/fixed/cover). supersete_pmf is a Poisson-binomial over 7 columns with p_i = marks_i/10; PRESETS registry holds every game's N/k/bonus/region.

features.name: Fantasy 5 draws + update
features.detail: List/search/delete/add/import draws. /api/update-draws merges the official Georgia Lottery latest result + lottonumbers.com year archives (full=true rebuilds 2015->now); dedups by date.

features.name: F5 build / ledger / verdict
features.detail: /api/build runs the curated funnel. /api/ledger runs ledger_run + montecarlo_control (default 2000 runs) with persisted prizes/cost and a date window. /api/ledger/verdict SSE-streams a blunt statistician verdict.

features.name: Universal game endpoints
features.detail: Game registry + per-game draws, curated build, backtest, cost-aware ledger and CSV import - all keyed on the PRESETS config and per-game data/draws/<id>.json stores.

features.name: Live results endpoints
features.detail: /api/g/update merges fresh draws for one game via live_sources; update-all walks every wired game in one request (~8.7s for 13 games) and also stores next-draw jackpots; latest-all returns all games' latest instantly from disk.

features.name: Chat (SSE) + AI status
features.detail: build_messages() picks the per-app system prompt and injects CURRENT APP STATE. /api/chat streams tokens as Server-Sent Events from Ollama (default) or a cloud provider. /api/ai/status lists local Ollama models (embeddings filtered) + keyed cloud models.

features.name: Settings / sets / plays / scratch / supersete
features.detail: Persisted prize+cost+model settings (settings.json); saved-set library (saved_sets.db); logged plays + analysis (plays.db); scratch EV CRUD (scratch.db); exact Super Sete odds.

features.name: Export (CSV / Excel)
features.detail: Writes a CSV or a styled openpyxl .xlsx play sheet (gold header, borders, strategy/avg-sum/hotzone metadata) with a safe filename.

features.name: US official (data.ny.gov)
features.detail: Socrata JSON for Powerball (d6yy-54nr; PB = 6th token), Mega Millions (5xaw-6ayf; mega_ball), Cash4Life (kwxv-fwze; cash_ball), ordered by draw_date desc.

features.name: Brazil official (Caixa)
features.detail: servicebus2.caixa.gov.br walks back from the latest contest to the last stored date (gap-close). Special bonus parsing: Dia de Sorte month-name -> 1-12, +Milionaria trevosSorteados.

features.name: Europe feeds
features.detail: France Loto from FDJ open data (data.opendatasoft.com); EuroMillions from the pedromealha community API. EuroJackpot/SuperEnalotto/UK/6-49 have no wired source (honest note; CSV still works).

features.name: Next-draw jackpot fetch
features.detail: Caixa valorEstimadoProximoConcurso for 8 BR games; Mega Millions official NextPrizePool (regex-extracted from GetLatestDrawData); Cash4Life fixed label. Powerball/EuroMillions deliberately None (no reliable free headless source).

features.name: Fantasy 5 sources
features.detail: Official galottery.com API gives only the latest draw(s); lottonumbers.com (BeautifulSoup, cross-validated) backfills full years. F5 keeps its own deep store, separate from the Universal per-game stores.

features.name: FastMCP stdio server
features.detail: Launched by Claude Desktop over stdio (registered in %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json, qi-brain preserved). Imports engine_py directly so the math is identical to the web app. No paid API - uses the Claude subscription.

features.name: 11 tools
features.detail: draws_info, number_heat, suggest_pool, generate_set, backtest_set, brutal_ledger, probability, update_draws, add_draw, build_play_set, check_winners. brutal_ledger also runs the random control + percentile in one call.

features.name: Draw stores (JSON)
features.detail: Fantasy 5: 4,222 draws (2015-01-01 -> 2026-06-15, galottery.com + lottonumbers). 14 per-game Universal stores (Powerball, Mega Millions, Cash4Life, Mega-Sena, Quina, Lotofacil, etc.) keyed {date, n, b?}.

features.name: SQLite stores
features.detail: plays.db = logged real plays for personal analytics; saved_sets.db = the Saved Sets library; scratch.db = sgames/stiers/splays for the scratch EV tracker (schema created on demand).

features.name: Browser engine (mirror)
features.detail: engine.js mirrors engine_py so the F5 page runs offline; general.js is the Universal client engine + UI. Both keep the same generation/backtest/odds math as the Python side.

features.name: Shared UI modules
features.detail: gamebar.js renders the shared region game-switcher on every page; aidock.js (WizDock) is the shared AI dock used by Universal/Super Sete/Scratch (FAB + drawer + model select + SSE + action-block parse). Fantasy5/app.js is the deep F5 controller.

features.name: QI_LotteryWiz NSSM service
features.detail: Self-elevating NSSM install: service QI_LotteryWiz, AppDirectory C:\Lottery Wiz, runs server.py, port 8777, auto-start, logs to LOGS\service.log. Registered in QI_Service_Registry.md. User must run install_service.bat (UAC) to make it permanent; backend edits need restart_service.bat.

features.name: QI_LotteryWizTunnel
features.detail: NSSM cloudflared tunnel exposing localhost:8777. Registry targets the static named tunnel at https://lottery.quiddityinnovations.com; quick-tunnel scripts (tunnel.bat / tunnel_url.bat) work without admin in the interim.
